title: FireSat first operational deployment mid-2026 — Earth Fire Alliance/Muon Space, twice-daily global wildfire observation
snippet: Earth Fire Alliance and Muon Space will deploy the first three operational FireSats in mid-2026, delivering twice-daily global observation for wildfire detection. First wildfire images released. Constellation designed to complement existing MODIS/VIIRS fire detection.
tag_reason: New satellite operations event: first operational FireSat deployment for wildfire detection
